items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I would work with Little Jim just before he passed. We played out at Seuss Barren... I played with John Casimir's band that had him. And again, I worked with him a couple of carnivals ago.

ctx.x: I never heard. What about Mac Lacey? Little Mac they called him.
Little Jim. I wonder if it's the same part that I have in mind. You used to call him Little Jim. Is he here?
No, that's another guy. I know Little Jim.
